name: web-tinted-alert-banners-info-warning-and-error-with-action-buttons
title: Three stacked tinted alerts: blue trial notice, amber API-key warning and red payment failure, each with an icon and an action
whatItIs: Three rounded banners on white: a soft blue 'Your trial expires in 3 days' with an info icon and an Upgrade button, an amber 'API key expires soon' with a warning triangle and Renew key, and a soft red 'Payment failed' with an error icon and Retry, each with bold title, a smaller description and a tinted button.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; tonal fills and matching icons signal severity without alarm.
techniques: Tint each banner in a semantic colour.
Pair title with a one-line description.

vocabulary.definition: A banner whose colour signals severity.
A button tinted in the alert's colour.
A button placed inside the banner.
